network: ctx.serve() is the DoH endpoint behind the kernel's realm proxy (dig posts application/dns-message in absolute form, so no CONNECT and no wasm-tls-engine); the uplink's 100.100.100.100:53 is a raw TCP peer speaking DNS over TCP. Both answer with dnsFake, which encodes real DNS wire messages. Checked by hand against cloudflare-dns.com and 1.1.1.1:53 with the host build.
checklist: full output: banner, ->>HEADER<<- (NOERROR, id 0 for DoH), flags qr rd ra, OPT pseudosection, QUESTION and ANSWER sections tab-aligned like dig, ;; SERVER https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query (HTTPS), MSG SIZE
+short for A, AAAA, MX, TXT (quoted, escaped), CNAME chain, NS, SOA, SRV, CAA, and -x PTR; bare type words in either position
NXDOMAIN: rc 0, SOA in AUTHORITY, empty +short
DNS over TCP to @100.100.100.100 through the uplink: answer, ;; SERVER …#53(…) (TCP), the dial in the uplink log; the tailnet name is NXDOMAIN over DoH
failures: refused @server → rc 9 'communications error' + 'no servers could be reached'; DoH 503 → rc 9; non-DNS content type → rc 9; +notcp → rc 1 'no UDP'; bad type → rc 1
AD flag (homescoop#177): queries set AD by default, so a validating resolver's answer prints `ad` (the fake sets it for signed.test); +noadflag clears it; +cdflag sets CD (echoed as `cd`)

BIND's columns (homescoop#177, masterdump.c indent()): TTL at 24, class 32, type 40, rdata 48, tabs then spaces; an owner wider than its column gets a space (`<long name>. 300 IN\tA 192.0.2.20`); the question counts columns without the `;`

DNSSEC presentation (homescoop#177, RFC 4034/5155 as BIND prints them): DNSKEY `257 3 13 <base64 in 56-character words>`, +nocrypto `[key id = 2371]`; DS `2371 13 2 <HEX in 56-character words>`; RRSIG with YYYYMMDDHHMMSS times and the signer, +nocrypto `[omitted]`; NSEC `\000.nonexist… RRSIG NSEC TYPE128`; NSEC3 base32hex hash and type list; NSEC3PARAM `1 0 0 -` (real cloudflare.com, ietf.org and nic.cz rdata)
HTTPS/SVCB (homescoop#403): `1 . alpn="h2"`; cloudflare.com's and crypto.cloudflare.com's real HTTPS rdata: alpn="h3,h2", ipv4hint/ipv6hint lists, ech= unsplit base64
unknown types (homescoop#403, RFC 3597): TYPE999 in the type column (question and answer) and `\# 4 01020304` as its data

DoH 502 (homescoop#177, #573): rc 9; a third-party endpoint gets the hint that it may be offline or not allow cross-origin requests from a browser (cloudflare-dns.com does); cloudflare-dns.com and 1.1.1.1 get `the network or the proxy failed`, no CORS hint

zero-length RDATA (#574): NULL and TYPE999 with rdlength 0 print `\\# 0` (rc 0); an empty A record is still `Got bad packet` (rc 9); DNSKEY/DS with no key or digest print `257 3 13` / `2371 13 2` with no trailing space
RRSIG times (#599): BIND's serial window around now, so expiration 0xffffffff prints 19691231235959; types 100–103 are UINFO, UID, GID, UNSPEC (`-t UID`, `\\# 4 000003E8`)
users enforce (#819): root, alice and bob get the same answer over DoH and TCP; alice can't write dig's output into bob's 0755 directory; bob's own output is his
